runtime.peak_rss: 1,375,834,112 bytes (1.38 GB) measured at --cpus=2 --memory=2g on the lab 5 image probe, 2026-09-19
runtime.note: ONE AGENT RUN PER PROCESS. An agent loop generates several times against one Llama object by construction and cannot obey the literal 'one generation per process' rule; what stays identical across runs is the tool-call chain and the broker verdicts, measured 3/3 in five configurations and unchanged at 2 vs 4 threads. Assertions key on verdict records, never on the model's prose - the agent narrates a success it was denied, deterministically.
